TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your conversations, meetings, and lectures. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, and proactively offers suggestions, so you never forget anything and always know what's next.

The app builds your Second Brain by capturing your life. Every capture builds TwinMind in the background, all day without draining your battery. It works in any of 140+ languages. The longer you use TwinMind, the more it can do for you.

ASK YOUR LIFE ANYTHING
Whatever the question, it answers from your conversations, email, and the web. One subscription covers pro ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini like Sol, Opus, Sonnet & Fable.

YOUR SECOND BRAIN
People and memorable moments get their own pages, updating daily. Days of captures read like an encyclopedia of your life.

PREPARED BEFORE YOU ASK
Your daily digest lands every morning with yesterday's highlights and today's priorities. Connect your calendar and email to get briefed on what's next, with replies already drafted.

TURN CONVERSATIONS INTO CREATIONS
Connect TwinMind to Claude or ChatGPT over MCP, and your memories become reports, prototypes, drafts, or anything you can describe.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

 – Researchers: Turn links, docs, and interviews into searchable transcripts, structured insights, and deep research reports.

Download Renote now — the smarter way to transcribe, summarize, research, and organize your ideas with AI.

Smart Noter is an AI note-taking app for professionals and students. It records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings, lectures, and any conversation, turning hours of audio into structured, searchable notes you can act on. Trusted by over 10 million users across 60+ languages.

KEY CAPABILITIES

AI Note-Taking: Smart Noter writes your notes for you. Every recording becomes organized notes with key points and clear headings, ready the moment you stop recording.

Recording and Transcription: Record any conversation and get an accurate transcript with automatic speaker identification, so you always know who said what.

Live Transcription: Every word appears on screen in real time as it is spoken, so you can follow and highlight key moments without writing anything down.

Live Translation: Follow any conversation in your own language. Smart Noter translates speech in real time across 60+ languages.

AI Summaries and Action Items: Each recording becomes a concise summary, with the action items and follow-ups pulled out automatically.

Chat with Your Notes: Ask questions about any recording and get instant answers, summaries, or decisions on demand.

Summarize Any Content: Import existing audio and video files or PDFs and get a full transcript and summary in one place.

Calendar Integration: Connect your calendar and get prepared notes for every scheduled meeting.

Works Offline: Record and capture notes anywhere, even without an internet connection.

Export and Share: Send your notes as PDF, DOCX, TXT, or SRT, or share them straight to Slack, Notion, and Google Docs.

FAQ

What is Smart Noter?
Smart Noter is an AI note-taking app that records and transcribes any conversation, then writes the notes for you. Instead of leaving you with raw audio, it identifies each speaker, summarizes the key points and action items, and lets you ask questions about what was said.

How does it work?

1. Record a meeting, lecture, or call, or import an audio or video file you already have.
2. Smart Noter transcribes the audio in real time and labels each speaker.
3. Turn on live translation to follow along in your own language.
4. Get a structured summary with the highlights and next steps.
5. Chat with your notes to find any detail, then export or share them wherever you work.

Who is Smart Noter for?
Smart Noter is built for professionals and students. Professionals use it to capture decisions and action items from client calls, standups, and board meetings. Students use it to turn lectures and seminars into clean transcripts and study notes. Researchers and interviewers use it for speaker-labeled transcripts they can search and quote. It fits anyone who needs to turn spoken conversations into organized, searchable notes.

Gumdrop is the best AI meeting prep and follow-through tool,  built for people who run on meetings.

The meeting space has become a mess. Every tool is bloated. Every product is "AI-powered" something. None of it actually helps when you're running from one call to the next.

Gumdrop focuses on two things, and does both really well: meeting prep before, and follow-through after.

Pre-meeting briefings
Five minutes before every call, Gumdrop provides you with a meeting brief including; a headshot,  summary of your last email exchanges, company enrichment, etc.  You get everything you need to now walk into that meeting, ready.

Follow-through that actually happens

Our AI notetaker joins your meetings, captures every action item and follow up request, and most importantly, hands them back to you as a list with dates assigned, right on your Gumdrop homepage. Gumdrop remembers so you don't have to.

• Pre-meeting briefings 5 minutes before every call

•  AI notetaker that captures every commitment
•  Relationship nudges so you never lose touch
•  Magic by Gumdrop — CC our AI scheduling agent
•  Solo and group booking links at gumdrop.ai/yourname

record.description_evidence:
AtanNote turns what you say into clear notes. Record a meeting, a class or a quick idea in Burmese, English or both, and AtanNote writes it up: the full transcript, a summary with the key points, and every action item with its owner. Then ask your notes anything.

Built for Burmese from day one. Use the whole app in Burmese or English, and switch anytime.

RECORD ANYWHERE, EVEN OFFLINE

• Tap record and talk. No signal? The recording saves on your phone and uploads when you are back online
• A live sound wave and level meter show when you are too quiet or too loud
• Keeps recording in the background, and pauses itself after a long silence
• Recording tips help you get a clear recording in any room

CLEAR NOTES, YOUR WAY

• Simple: just the transcript, word for word
• Summary: one complete summary, with the topics covered at the top, decisions, key points and action items
• Longer recordings, YouTube links and documents start as a Summary. Switch any note between Simple and Summary
• Burmese and English in the same sentence, and every word is caught
• An AI title for every note, and a language of your choice for each note
• Translate a summary into another language (paid plans)

ASK AI ABOUT YOUR NOTES

• Ask about one note, a few notes or your whole library
• Every answer shows the notes it came from
• Suggested questions right inside the chat box
• Save any answer as a new note

TO-DOS THAT GET DONE

• Action items come with an owner, ready for your To-do list
• Due dates, priorities, and overdue tasks pinned to the top
• Reminders so nothing slips (Pro)

BRING IN ANYTHING

• YouTube links
• Documents: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text and CSV
• Audio files: MP3, M4A, MP4, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG and WEBM
• Share audio from any app straight into AtanNote
• Scan text from photos, several photos into one note

REWRITE IN ANY STYLE

• 50+ writing styles, from formal minutes to a friendly message
• Make your own styles (paid plans)
• Rewrite in another language anytime

LISTEN BACK

• Play the original recording inside the note
• Drag the wave to find a moment, and play at 0.75× to 2×
• Trim a recording. The original is kept, and Reset brings it back

TEACH IT YOUR WORDS

• Fix a name or a term once, and AtanNote gets it right next time
• Edit, add or delete any summary line
• Every version is kept, with a way back (restore on paid plans)

ORGANIZED AND EASY TO FIND

• Folders with colors and icons
• Search that understands meaning, not just exact words
• Your notes stay readable offline
• Share a note with a link

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

• Your recordings and notes are never used to train AI, ours or anyone else's
• Encrypted at rest and in transit, and stored in Singapore
• Never sold, and nobody at AtanNote reads your notes
• Delete a recording, a note or your whole account anytime
• App lock with fingerprint, face or passcode
• Sign in with Apple, Google, a passkey or a code sent to your email

PLANS

AtanNote Free:
• 2 hours of transcription in total, up to 30 minutes per recording
• Recording itself is unlimited; only transcription counts
• Summaries, rewrite and Ask AI on every note
• Up to 3 folders

AtanNote Go, for everyday notes:
• 6 hours of transcription every month, up to 1 hour per recording
• Translate summaries, version history, your own styles and unlimited folders
• Edits made offline sync when you reconnect

AtanNote Pro, for meetings and lectures:
• Unlimited transcription, up to 2 hours per recording
• Everything in Go, plus to-do reminders

Try Pro free before you pay: 3 days on monthly, 7 days on yearly. Cancel anytime.

MADE FOR

• Teams and managers: meeting notes, decisions and to-dos
• Students: lectures, study notes and exam prep
• Anyone with an idea on the go

Terms of Use: https://atannote.ai/terms

record.description_evidence:
Feature Overview

Vocal Extractor separates songs in your Music Library into vocals and accompaniment with just a tap of a button on the main screen (*1), instantly creating karaoke and a cappella tracks.

The generated vocal and backing (karaoke) tracks can be saved as files and exported to iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, and other platforms. This allows you to use the isolated tracks in other applications or on different platforms (*2).

Unlike traditional apps based on OOPS (Out of Phase Stereo) technology, Vocal Extractor leverages AI and deep learning to separate vocals from songs, including monaural recordings and tracks where the vocals are not center-panned—cases where traditional apps cannot remove vocals.

You can import music files in mp3, m4a, or wav formats from iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, and other sources. This includes live recordings created with other apps, allowing you to remove or extract vocals from them.

The embedded player allows you to toggle between the original, vocal, or backing tracks while playing the audio.

*1. Only songs downloaded to your device and not protected by DRM can be used as source data.
*2. Saved output files will have a sampling rate of 44.1kHz and be in m4a or wav format, either mono or stereo. Saving files is an in-app purchase feature. We recommend testing the vocal separation quality in the embedded player before purchasing.

How to Use

1.Launch the App
 After the launch screen, the main screen will appear. Tap the Music Library button, select a song, and load it into the app.

2.Extract Vocals
 Tap the Vocal Extract button in the center of the main screen. The extraction process will begin, and once completed, the Vocal, Backing, and Save buttons will become active.

3.Playback Tracks
 Select either the Original, Vocal, or Backing track and tap the Play Back button to listen to the chosen track.

4.Save Tracks
 After extraction, the Save Vocal and Save Backing buttons will be enabled. The first time you tap one of these buttons, the in-app purchase screen will appear. Before purchasing,  we recommend confirming the quality of the vocal separation in the embedded player. Once purchased, the in-app purchase screen will no longer appear, and you can save files after confirming via a pop-up.

5.File Naming
 Saved files will be named with the original file name (excluding the suffix) plus "_vocal.m4a" or "_backing.m4a". File renaming is not supported in this version. Output files are in 44.1kHz m4a or wav format.

6.Export Files
 To export files from the app container, tap the Export button. A list of saved files will appear. Select a file and tap the Export menu in the navigation bar. The document provider screen will appear, allowing you to choose a location to save the file. A pop-up will confirm when the export has started successfully. Exporting occurs in the background.

7.Import Source Files
 You can use m4a, mp3, and wav files as source data. Place these files in iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, or another document provider configured on your iPhone. Then, tap the Import button to add the file to the app's container.

8.Load Imported Files
 After importing a file, tap the File button to see a list of imported files. Select a file and tap the Load menu in the navigation bar to load the content for extraction or playback.

9.Document Provider Compatibility
 Import and export functions only work with document providers properly configured on your device.

For more information, visit http://vocalextractor.com/en/.

Discover the Magic of Music Creation with AI Music App!

Unlock your inner musician and create complete, studio-quality songs in just seconds with AI Music App. Whether you're looking to compose your next chart-topping hit, have some musical fun, or craft a unique greeting for a special occasion, AI Music App is your ultimate music-making companion.

KEY FEATURES:
► INSTANT SONG CREATION
Transform your lyrics into fully-produced songs within seconds. Experience the magic of instant music creation at your fingertips.

► WRITE YOUR LYRICS
Unleash your creativity by crafting your own lyrics directly within the app. Dive deep into the art of songwriting and watch your words come to life.

► CREATE LYRICS FROM A PROMPT
Have a specific idea or theme? Simply type it in, and our AI will generate lyrics that perfectly match your vision.

► CHOOSE YOUR MUSIC GENRE
From Rock, Pop, Hip-hop, and Country to Electronic and beyond, Music Beat can tailor the tunes to fit any genre you desire.

► GENERATE RANDOM LYRICS
Stuck in a creative rut? Let our AI inspire you with unique, randomly generated lyrics to kickstart your songwriting journey.

► GENERATE INSTRUMENTALS
Need a tune without lyrics? Music Beat can create instrumental tracks in any genre, perfect for setting the mood or adding a musical background to any project.

► GENERAL COMMERCIAL LICENSE
Gain full commercial rights to use your music however you see fit. Perfect for creators looking to monetize their work or businesses in need of original music for promotional activities.

► STUDIO-QUALITY SOUND
Every track produced with Music Beat boasts studio-quality sound, ensuring your music sounds professional and polished.

► EASY SHARING
Effortlessly share your musical creations with friends and family or upload them directly to streaming platforms.

Whether you're an aspiring songwriter or just looking to experiment with music creation, Music Beat is here to enhance your creative expression. Download Music Beat now and discover how easy and exciting making music can be!
